$comment: Canonical wire-protocol fixtures for the mobile tunnel (#240 / #46). Shared by base-studio-code (TS tests in src/__tests__/tunnel.test.ts import it; the future Rust relay transport in src-tauri/src/tunnel.rs will assert against it) and by mobile-studio-code, whose src/lib/types.ts is the source of truth. These application frames are carried UNCHANGED inside the relay's Noise-encrypted envelope ({room, ciphertext}) — the Cloudflare relay never sees them in plaintext. Messages are flat JSON tagged by a snake_case `type`; multi-word field names are camelCase. See docs/tunnel-protocol.md.
